ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution with approximately 70% low-intensity (black) pixels dominant in the central and trailing edge regions and 30% high-intensity (white) pixels localized on the distal lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white blobs located on the lateral tips of both lobes, featuring irregular, feathered boundaries and small dark focal spots transitioning into a solid low-intensity black central region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 42 degrees and a depth roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; notably higher pixel-amplitude peaks on the left lobe compared to the right; multiple micro-indentations visible.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curvature on the lower leading edges tapering to sharp distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of dark, circular pixel clusters on the white distal patches; prominent brownish-orange high-contrast protrusion on the far-left terminal edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct series of dark, parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the white pigmentation of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable brownish biological growth or epiphytic lesion on the extreme left lateral tip; irregular trailing edge trauma on the upper left lobe margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique bifurcated dark linear mark on the right lobe's white field; distinct vertical dark streak near the lower edge of the left white patch.
